-- Match results with parsed goals and winner information
-- Each row is one match with home and away team stats
-- Raw results live in one table per season (raw_eliteserien_results_<season>)

with raw_eliteserien_results as (
   





    
    





select * from "raw_eliteserien_results_2021"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliteserien_results_2022"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliteserien_results_2023"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliteserien_results_2024"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliteserien_results_2025"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliteserien_results_2026"




)

select
    season,
    date,
    matchday,
    home_team,
    away_team,
    result,
    cast(split_part(result, ':', 1) as integer) as home_goals,
    cast(split_part(result, ':', 2) as integer) as away_goals,
    -- Determine match winner
    case
        when home_goals > away_goals then 'home_team'
        when away_goals > home_goals then 'away_team'
        else 'draw'
    end as winner,
    snapshot_at,
    ingested_at
from raw_eliteserien_results
order by season, date, matchday

with t1 as (
   





    
    





select * from "raw_eliterserien_goal_contributions_2021"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliterserien_goal_contributions_2022"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliterserien_goal_contributions_2023"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliterserien_goal_contributions_2024"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliterserien_goal_contributions_2025"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliterserien_goal_contributions_2026"




),

/* Create a dimension table for all player names with their latest name and date */
dim_players_1 as (

SELECT
        scorer_player_id AS player_id,
        scorer_name AS player_name,
        date
    FROM t1
    WHERE scorer_player_id IS NOT NULL
      AND scorer_name IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        assist_player_id AS player_id,
        assist_name AS player_name,
        date
    FROM t1
    WHERE assist_player_id IS NOT NULL
      AND assist_name IS NOT NULL
),

/* Filter to get the latest player name for each player */
dim_players_2 as (
SELECT
    distinct
    player_id,
    player_name AS latest_name,
    date AS latest_date
FROM dim_players_1
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    PARTITION BY player_id
    ORDER BY date DESC, player_name ASC
) = 1
),

/* Create the final fact table by joining the goal contributions with the latest player names */
final as (


select 
a.season,
a.date,
a.matchday,
a.home_team,
a.away_team,
b.latest_name as scorer_name,
a.scorer_player_id,
c.latest_name as assist_name,
a.assist_player_id,
a.scorer_team,
a.score,
a.is_own_goal
from t1 a 
left join dim_players_2 b
on a.scorer_player_id = b.player_id
left join dim_players_2 c
on a.assist_player_id = c.player_id

)

select *
from final

-- Canonical team names available in each Eliteserien season.
with teams as (
    select
        season,
        home_team as team_name
    from "brann"."main"."fct_matches"

    union

    select
        season,
        away_team as team_name
    from "brann"."main"."fct_matches"
)

select
    season,
    team_name
from teams
order by season, team_name

-- League standings after each matchday
-- Shows cumulative points, goals, and position for each team

with matches as (
    select * from "brann"."main"."fct_matches"
),

-- Split each match into two rows (one per team)
home as (
    select
        season,
        matchday,
        home_team as team,
        home_goals as goals_for,
        away_goals as goals_against,
        case
            when home_goals > away_goals then 3
            when home_goals = away_goals then 1
            else 0
        end as points
    from matches
),

away as (
    select
        season,
        matchday,
        away_team as team,
        away_goals as goals_for,
        home_goals as goals_against,
        case
            when away_goals > home_goals then 3
            when away_goals = home_goals then 1
            else 0
        end as points
    from matches
),

all_results as (
    select * from home
    union all
    select * from away
),

-- Cumulative stats per team per matchday
standings as (
    select
        season,
        matchday,
        team,
        sum(points) over (partition by season, team order by matchday) as total_points,
        sum(goals_for) over (partition by season, team order by matchday) as total_goals_for,
        sum(goals_against) over (partition by season, team order by matchday) as total_goals_against,
        (sum(goals_for) over (partition by season, team order by matchday)) -
        (sum(goals_against) over (partition by season, team order by matchday)) as goal_difference
    from all_results
),

-- Add table position
final as (
    select
        season,
        matchday,
        team,
        total_points,
        total_goals_for,
        total_goals_against,
        goal_difference,
        row_number() over (partition by season, matchday order by total_points desc, goal_difference desc) as position
    from standings
)

select * from final
order by season desc, matchday desc, position

WITH all_player_names_goal_contributions AS (
    SELECT
        scorer_player_id AS player_id,
        scorer_name AS player_name,
        date
    FROM "brann"."main"."fct_goal_contributions"
    WHERE scorer_player_id IS NOT NULL
      AND scorer_name IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        assist_player_id AS player_id,
        assist_name AS player_name,
        date
    FROM "brann"."main"."fct_goal_contributions"
    WHERE assist_player_id IS NOT NULL
      AND assist_name IS NOT NULL
),

/* Union all years */
all_player_names_lineups_1 as (








    
    





select * from "raw_eliterserien_lineups_2021"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliterserien_lineups_2022"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliterserien_lineups_2023"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliterserien_lineups_2024"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliterserien_lineups_2025"
union all by name

select * from "raw_eliterserien_lineups_2026"





),


/* All player names from lineups */
all_player_names_lineups_2 AS (

SELECT
    distinct
    player_id,
    player_name AS latest_name,
    date AS latest_date
FROM all_player_names_lineups_1

),


all_player_names AS (
    SELECT * FROM all_player_names_goal_contributions
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM all_player_names_lineups_2
),


final as (
    SELECT
        distinct
        player_id,
        player_name AS latest_name,
        date AS latest_date
    FROM all_player_names
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY player_id
        ORDER BY date DESC, player_name ASC
    ) = 1
)

select * from final
